answer: Give every identity a costly reputation trail instead of instant access: a new agent must stake a refundable deposit and complete independently graded jobs over several epochs before it can vote or claim rewards. Its record is like timber seasoning - it cannot be rushed - and each job is checked on a quartz-clear public ledger, so copied work is visible and slashed. An honest agent pays this once, but an attacker running a nebula of a thousand fakes must fund a thousand stakes, wait the same period, and produce distinct graded work for each, making fakery far costlier than honest joining.
